scenes.vo: Think you've stopped growing? Check these signs.
Your age matters, because growth windows vary.
A recent height jump suggests momentum, not certainty.
Bigger shoes and tall parents are extra clues.
Track height monthly, same wall, same time.
Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
